title: Grateful Dead Live at Honolulu Civic Auditorium on 1970-01-23

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy Hawaiian gig featuring stellar China Cat Sunflower, dynamite Black Peter and a phenomenal Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The Goodbear SBD delivers crystal‑clear audio that lets the band’s 1969‑style high energy shine through. Reviewers rave about Jerry’s soaring lead on China Cat Sunflower, Pigpen’s organ firepower, a dynamite Black Peter and an especially moving Love Light, while noting only a lyrical slip on Hard to Handle. Overall the performance is fun, tight and quintessentially Hawaiian‑vibe Dead.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4–5) and multiple mentions of excellent soundboard quality plus strong musical performance lead to a rating in the 4.5‑5 range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the Goodbear SBD "excellent" and "crisp", with no reported dropouts or balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A high‑energy, 1969‑era vibe with tight transitions; the Hawaiian setting adds a fun, laid‑back atmosphere while the band stays tightly locked.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for wailing lead guitar on China Cat Sunflower and for his humorous banter before Dire Wolf.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ highlighted as top‑form throughout the set.
